title: Phish's Trey Anastasio Performs, Talks Springsteen on 'Howard Stern'
summary: The Phish frontman joins Howard for an interview, live acoustic performance, and bonus song for the SiriusXM app.
body_markdown:
Phish frontman Trey Anastasio is making his first-ever appearance on[The Howard Stern Show](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/howard-stern) on Monday, November 2, for an interview and live acoustic performance.


[Howard Stern Show Howard’s interviews, bits & more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTreyAnastasioHSS)


Trey will chat with Howard Stern from his New York City studio at approximately 9:15am ET, closing out the live broadcast with a conversation and a performance of one song.


Following the show, the Phish founder will record a second song exclusively for the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTreyAnastasioHSS) , giving fans an additional performance they won’t hear during the live broadcast.


### **How to Listen**


Tune in to *The Howard Stern Show* on[Howard 100 (Ch. 100)](https://www.siriusxm.com/channels/howard-100) on Monday, November 2, with Anastasio’s appearance expected around 9:15am ET.


The full three-hour show will replay throughout Monday and be available on the SiriusXM app that day. Additional replays will air on Howard 100 throughout Wednesday, Thursday, and Saturday.


Need more Phish? Explore the Phish multiverse with the legendary band’s exclusive 24/7 SiriusXM channel,[Phish Radio (Ch. 29)](https://www.siriusxm.com/channels/phish-radio) . Tune in on your car radio or the SiriusXM app for an extensive live archive, studio tracks, musical influences, and exclusive commentary from band members. You’ll also hear specialty shows hosted by the band, complete concert broadcasts from tour stops, and plenty of surprises taboot.
